minutes_text:
MINUTES
  ADJOURNED PARK AND ACTIVTIES COMMISSION MEETING
  JUNE 18, 2018

  An adjourned meeting of the Park and Activities Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates
  was scheduled for June 18, 2018 at 6:00 p.m. at Ernie Howlett Park, 25851 Hawthorne Blvd.,
  Rolling Hills Estates, California.

  Due to a lack of quorum, with only CHAIR ROMANELLI, COMMISSIONER PORTUGAL and
  COMMISSIONER RETZ present, CHAIR ROMANELLI adjourned the meeting at 6:20 p.m. to the
  adjourned Park & Activities Commission meeting of July 16, 2018 at 6:00 p.m. at Highridge Park,
  29035 Highridge Road, Rolling Hills Estates, CA 90274.

  Respectfully submitted,  Approved,

  _________________________________  _________________________________
  Carol Corea  Heidi Luce
  Minutes Secretary  City Clerk
